title: Training Q&A — Registered Guest Stays and the Water First-Block Bound, Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
**Rule.** For the water usage charge on a Utility Pass-Through Service account, a guest stay registered with the community that began in the last two months, counted as fewer than two whole months separating its first day from the handling date, widens the first-block bound by half of the schedule's first-block bound when its planned last day falls fourteen or more days after its first day and by a quarter of that bound when its planned last day falls fewer than fourteen days after its first day; the most recently begun registered stay is the one read, and without a stay begun in the last two months the first-block bound is not widened.

Guest stays are registered on the site's Community Rules & Site Care records, each with a first day and a planned last day.

## Questions answered

**Q. How large is the widening?** One half (0.5) of the schedule's own first-block bound, as printed in the water rate schedule, for a stay of 14 days or more; one quarter (0.25) of it for a stay of fewer than 14 days. The widening is added to the first-block bound used for the charge.

**Q. How is the stay's length measured?** As the planned last day less the first day, in days.

**Q. What does "began in the last two months" mean?** Fewer than 2 whole months separate the stay's first day from the handling date.

**Q. Two stays are registered. Which one counts?** The most recently begun one — the stay with the latest first day.

**Q. Worked through (handling date 10 June, hypothetical, schedule first-block bound 3.00 kgal).**

| Most recently begun registered stay | Began in the last 2 months? | Length | Widening |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 April to 10 May | Yes | 20 days | 1.50 kgal (half of 3.00) |
| 25 May to 7 June | Yes | 13 days | 0.75 kgal (a quarter of 3.00) |
| 25 May to 8 June | Yes | 14 days | 1.50 kgal |
| 5 April to 25 April | No (2 whole months) | 20 days | not widened |
